WSK70377 SOPERIOR ABSTRACT RECORDED BROOKLYN, 105 COURT b ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMER7 18322-0364 STREET 6lc 112 Lo+ AgreementmadeasofOctober30,2003,byGRECOROMANREALTYCORP.,aNew /3 ,LLC, having an address at 17 Keap Street, Brooklyn, NY 11211, as Tenant in Common to the extent WITNESSETH WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of that certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, Kings County, City and State of New York, known as Block 55, Lots 13 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (the ^Tax Map*"), and as and by the street address 202 Front Street,Brooklyn, NewYork which lies below the horizontal plans having an elevation of five (5) feet above the top of the highest structure or portion of Owner Building (as hereinafter defined) as it exists on the date hereof (the“Horizontal Plane"),and more particularly described in Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; the buildings located thereon are collectively referred to as the "Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of that certain volume of space, located in the Borough of Brooklyn, Kings County City and State of New York, which lies above the Horizontal Plane, also part of Block 55, Lots 13 on the Tax Map, and more particularly described on Exhibit "B"annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the“AirspaceParcel"); WHEREAS,Developer intends to construct an enlargement to an existing building, a new building, and/or other improvements associated with such enlargement or new building (the enlargement and/or new building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Building"); and the Airspace Parcel and the Developer Building are herein collectively referred to as the“Developer Parcel";(the Developer Parcel and the Owner Parcel are herein collectively referred to as the “Property"); WHEREAS, the Owner Building may contain less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), then is now available for use on the Owner Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) may be available for transfer to and utilization on the Developer Parcel and any Additional Parcel (as hereinafter defined);
